stops.name: Solling-Vogler
stops.detail: The Solling-Vogler region invites you to explore nature and adventure in a truly captivating setting. As part of the Weser Uplands, this walking region offers the best of both worlds: bordered by the romantic Weser river valley and dotted with picturesque towns and villages, it rises into a dramatic low mountain landscape with rugged cliffs and sweeping views. In [dated source], the region was awarded the ‘Walkable Germany’ quality certification ( ‘Wanderbares Deutschland’ Quality Region ) by the Deutscher Wanderverband (German Hiking Association).
